Advance structured PNR norms and fused GPU click sampling

Validate 12M new pure-state records and replay 4M historical noisy records. Fix the tested zero-probability endpoint while retaining strong-pure-state compression errors and tail diagnostics.

Halve matrix/mean workspace and add warp reductions. Validate 64 complete small laws, 16384-record capacity, and 57 resumed Frugal panels without splicing interrupted timings.

Validation: 4699 independent checks; 872 tests run, 843 passed, zero failures/errors; eleven new interface tests. Retain both initial Windows runtime registration failures.
